title: Top Account Rapid Intake SLO and Fallback Commitment Framework
creator: Marco Ruiz
description:
Problem: Strategic customers and prospects sometimes escalate roadmap asks during negotiation or renewal windows. Current intake is ad-hoc: requests land in multiple inboxes, SLAs are unclear, and engineering/PD handoffs lack commitment guarantees. That causes missed expectations and deal risk.

Objective: Define and implement a repeatable Rapid Intake SLO and a deterministic Fallback Commitment Framework for top accounts so Sales/CS can give consistent answers to customers while protecting roadmap predictability. The framework should: (1) score inbound escalations for priority and commitment likelihood, (2) guarantee an internal response SLO to customer-facing teams, (3) provide a classification of commitment outcomes (committed, scoped-deferred, workaround-fund), and (4) log all overrides for audit and postmortem.

Scope: Product + Eng + Design work to create intake forms, scoring rules, routing, and a canned set of commitment outcomes. Includes console UI for intake owners, an API webhook to notify account owners, and a short SLA statement templates for Sales. Excludes major billing changes and Dedicated contract amendments (handled by legal).

Success metrics: average response time to triage (target <= 48h), fraction of top-account escalations with explicit commitment outcome (target >= 90%), NPS impact on renewal conversations (qualitative tracking), and number of roadmap regressions caused by ad-hoc commitments (target 0).
acceptance_criteria: Formal intake form exists in Console with fields for customer, opportunity id, impact signals, and requested deliverable
Algorithmic priority score computed from deal size, renewal window, usage delta, incident involvement, and support severity
Response SLO implemented: auto-routing within 48h to assigned product owner or 'No-Commitment' template
Fallback Commitment Framework documented with three outcomes (Committed & ETA, Scoped-Deferred with evaluation window, Workaround-Fund with timelines)
Audit logs for manual overrides visible in Console and linked to ticket
Sales-facing SLA templates stored in Drive and linked in Console
Integration with CS/Sales Slack channel for instant notifications and opt-in escalations
